name: upscaler-skills
description: Core Upscaler agent skills: compliance-manager Q&A, asset-definition authoring, register-entry writes, and record drafting (a human completes each task). Prefers the Upscaler MCP server; falls back to the upscaler CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Upscaler anything, author assets, write register entries, draft records for human completion.
interface.longDescription: The core Upscaler agent-skill library, organised around a compliance-manager Q&A entry point (upscaler-ask) that routes to three workflow spokes: authoring of valid policy/procedure/register/record/course definitions (upscaler-author-asset), register-entry creation and updates (upscaler-write-entry), and record-instance creation plus task drafting for human completion (upscaler-run-record). Skills prefer the Upscaler MCP server and fall back to the upscaler CLI.
